## 7. AI Workflows & Tactics

- **Date:** 2026-09-28
- **Link:** [YouTube — How to Use Claude Routines – Full Workflow Automation Guide 2026](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w4MbjaMFrAM)
- **Summary:** The workflow shows how to create a scheduled “daily AI brief” routine in Claude using a plain-language instruction, with a local setup first and optional remote execution later.
- **Tools/models:** Claude, Claude Code Routines, optional remote connectors such as Gmail or Slack.
- **Setup:** Open `claude.ai/code/routines`; create a new routine; choose local for fastest setup; add a name, description, instructions, and schedule; test locally; move to remote only if always-on execution or connectors are required.
- **Available now:** Presented as available in Claude Routines research preview.
- **Why it matters:** The practical pattern is lightweight: replace deterministic node-based automation with a scheduled agent that can reason over changing inputs, useful for recurring research, inbox triage, repo checks, or brief generation.
